projection: orthogonal cardinal ground axes; height projects upward, not diamond isometric

palette.reason: Authoritative checkout and named shared palette were unavailable. No other worker palette or scale was changed.

autotile_scheme.required_corner_overlays: If both adjacent cardinals match but diagonal differs, add matching concave corner overlay.
autotile_scheme.optional_corner_overlays: If neither adjacent cardinal matches, add the matching convex wear overlay.
